description: Default capabilities for the Loach main window
comment: Only the window methods the renderer actually calls are granted.
TitleBar's control union is minimize | toggleMaximize | close, plus
isMaximized() and the data-tauri-drag-region hit area.
Deliberately NOT granted: maximize / unmaximize (we only ever toggle),
and hide / show (the tray drives those from Rust, which the ACL doesn't
gate). Granting them handed a compromised renderer window control it has
Not listed because the core:*:default sets below cover them: is-maximized
(core:app:default), and the event + path sets. core:resources:default
closes the updater's Update handle. process:default is exit + restart.
Deliberately NOT granted: core:default's image, menu and tray sets. The
renderer uses none of them, and core:image:default let it read any PNG
on disk through Image.fromPath, which has no path scope.
